digest.component_or_area: criteria vocabulary migration and repository guard
propositions: A deterministic repository scanner with a plain-text tab-delimited allowlist must guard against reintroduction of deprecated Success Criteria vocabulary while preserving frozen migration evidence, Jira captures, and four permanent semantic carve-outs

The guard must enforce exact-phrase and scoped bare-token (SC, SCs) matching case-insensitively, excluding docs/archive/**, docs/experiments/**, the minified editor.js bundle, and generated/cache directories

Three residual live-prose sites (src/rebar/llm/completion.py, tests/interfaces/store/test_completion_verifier.py, docs/sample-ticket-log.jsonl) must migrate from Success Criteria to Acceptance Criteria vocabulary
The guard must fail when actual phrase counts drift below or above pinned allowlist values, and reject malformed, duplicate, absent-path, or vacuous allowlist entries
The root Makefile lint target must invoke the guard, and live-source injections of the deprecated vocabulary must cause lint to exit non-zero
All four O-RAN-SC occurrences and minified vendor bundle must remain byte-identical to commit a475e24fc9c6edb2c52afc06677803386f45899c and outside the bare-token rule scope
